title: Madras HC allows State to give jobs on compassionate basis for Karur stampede victims’ families but...
description: The Madras High Court on Friday permitted the Tamil Nadu government to distribute appointment orders for jobs given on a compassionate basis to the families of those killed in the Karur stampede, but directed that the employment would remain temporary and subject to further orders [Theeran Thirumurugan Vs Chief Secretary].A Bench of Justices CV Karthikeyan and R Sakthivel said it would examine whether such appointments could be made without a uniform government policy governing employment offere
